items.body_raw: רָאָה אֱלֹהִים אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְהִנֵּה טוֹב מְאֹד
items.answer_raw: God saw all that he had made, and, behold, it was very good.

items.body_raw: וְאֵין אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל טוֹב מִמֶּנּוּ מִשִּׁכְמוֹ וָמַעְלָה גָּבֹהַּ מִכָּל־הָעָם
items.answer_raw: There was no man of the Israelites goodlier than he: from his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.

items.body_raw: Art thou my son or not?
